quick_facts.sprint_goal: Make the entire system demo-able. Every role can log in, navigate to their screen, and perform their core task — without any hand-holding or URL hacking.
quick_facts.priority_note: HIGHEST PRIORITY SPRINT. All backend + Sprint 3 frontend exists but is un-navigable. This sprint is the bridge to demo.

content.tldr: Sprint 4 is the 'demo unlock' sprint. Backend is 100% feature-complete through Sprint 3. Sprint 4 ties everything together with a shared AppLayout, role-aware navigation, and admin UI for stores and users.
why_this_sprint: POS, Orders, Invoices pages all exist but there is no nav — users must manually type URLs
No role-based landing: cashier, accountant, and manager all see the same fallback
Admin has no UI (no store management, no user management)
Customer demo requires a navigable, role-coherent experience

features_committed.title: AppLayout + Sidebar + Role-Aware Navigation
features_committed.rationale: Foundation for all other UI work this sprint. Without layout, nothing is navigable.
tasks: T010: Create frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx — responsive sidebar + topnav shell
T011: Sidebar items filtered by role (cashier → POS + Orders; accountant → Invoices + Reports; manager → all; admin → all + Admin panel)
T012: Role-based default landing redirect (cashier → /pos, accountant → /invoices, manager → /orders, admin → /admin/stores)
T013: Logout button in topnav, clears Zustand auth store + redirects to /login
T014: Wrap all protected routes in AppLayout in App.tsx

features_committed.title: Store Management UI (Admin)
features_committed.rationale: Admin has no UI. Store creation is currently only possible via API. Demo requires admin to onboard a store visually.
tasks: T015: Page /admin/stores — list all stores (name, taxCode, status, createdAt)
T016: Create store form (RHF + Zod: name required, taxCode 10-digit required, address)
T017: Deactivate store action with confirmation dialog
T018: Wire to GET /stores (admin), POST /stores, PATCH /stores/:id/deactivate

features_committed.title: User Management UI (Admin)
features_committed.rationale: Admin currently cannot create users via UI. Demo requires admin to create a cashier/accountant account and assign to a store.
tasks: T019: Page /admin/users — list all users (email, role, store, status)
T020: Create user form (email, password, role selector, store selector)
T021: Deactivate user action
T022: Wire to GET /auth/users (admin), POST /auth/register (admin-create), PATCH /auth/users/:id/deactivate

also_this_sprint: Add Vitest + React Testing Library setup (sprint-2 retrospective action item)
AppLayout responsive: sidebar collapses to icon-only on mobile
Active nav item highlight based on current route

qa_tasks.rationale: QA gap identified 2026-04-13: unit tests exist for backend services but integration tests, frontend unit tests, and Playwright E2E are missing across all 5 shipped features. Playwright setup pulled forward from Sprint 12 — no regression safety net until E2E exists.
tasks: QA-T001: Install Playwright — npm install -D @playwright/test && npx playwright install chromium — create e2e/ directory and playwright.config.ts (baseURL: http://localhost, browser: chromium)
QA-T002: Write TC-ORDER-E01 (P0) — cashier full POS flow E2E: login → /pos → search product → add to cart → confirm payment → invoice number visible — file: e2e/pos.spec.ts
QA-T003: Write TC-AUTH-E01 + TC-AUTH-E02 — login happy path + invalid credentials error message — file: e2e/auth.spec.ts
QA-T004: Create LoginPage + PosPage + InvoicePage Page Object Model (POM) classes — file: e2e/pages/
QA-T005: Set up NestJS integration test infrastructure — AppModule with test DB (port 5433), global beforeAll/afterAll cleanup — file: backend/test/app.e2e-setup.ts
QA-T006: Write auth integration tests TC-AUTH-I01 through TC-AUTH-I05 — login, refresh, logout, me, token rotation — file: backend/src/modules/auth/auth.e2e-spec.ts
QA-T007: Write frontend unit tests TC-AUTH-FU01 through TC-AUTH-FU04 — useAuthStore + api-client interceptors — file: frontend/src/stores/auth.store.spec.ts + frontend/src/lib/api-client.spec.ts
QA-T008: Verify Vitest coverage: npm run test:coverage — target >70% on service layer, report gaps to PM

prerequisites: Backend: GET /auth/users, POST /auth/register, PATCH /auth/users/:id — need to verify or implement

demo_scenario.title: End-to-End Demo Flow
steps: Admin logs in → lands on /admin/stores → creates 'Cửa hàng A' with taxCode
Admin goes to /admin/users → creates cashier account → assigns to store
Cashier logs in → auto-redirected to /pos → searches product → adds to cart → confirms payment
Accountant logs in → lands on /invoices → views invoice → sees VAT breakdown

api_contracts_needed: Verify GET /auth/users (admin), PATCH /auth/users/:id exist — if not, add to sprint backlog
